'''Kessa''' was the [[Color/Legends|blue-white]] primary [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by three [[Planet/Legends|planets]].

==Description==
Kessa was a [[Color/Legends|blue-white]] [[Star/Legends#Types of stars|B-type]] main sequence [[Star/Legends|star]]. Kessa was the primary of the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]] in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]]. It had three orbits, [[Senna/Legends|Senna]], [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] and [[Karedda]].
